participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Served the beer, and left the cat where he was.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Stayed at the back loom, and did not add to the story.
participation.name: Gillis Verbeke

story.body: You took the filled horn at twopence and the meal at threepence. You did not argue either price. You heard the loaf measured against the notch, and you left the cat on the Golding. You gave her the morning in one plain sentence and did not quote the king at her table.

relations.quote: Twopence, when you take it upstairs.

relations.quote: He has always had a Norwich face.

title: Paid for the horn and sat to the board
